summary: Reject known Hayatoku3 Tokaido/Sanyo class and requested-route train mismatches while preserving unresolved transfer/inventory rules; bound MCP HTTP header reads.
reason: Product comparison must enforce known corridor facility/category restrictions without asserting actual eligibility, prices or through services. Incomplete HTTP headers must be bounded before request authentication.
validated_outcome: Before the fix, three route/class regressions failed; all ten product boundary cases now pass. A real TCP incomplete-header request is closed by the production HTTP server after five seconds without reaching the handler; existing auth/TLS tests also pass.
